entries.title: Release notes sidebar
entries.prompt: Prototype a compact bb sidebar plugin that watches one GitHub repository and turns merged pull requests into editable release notes. Show the populated desktop state with grouped changes, author avatars, a tone selector, and a primary Copy draft action. Keep it utilitarian and monochrome.

scene.name: Release notes sidebar
scene.altText: A hand-drawn release notes sidebar interface concept.

entries.title: Token drift inspector
entries.prompt: Design a Figma plugin panel for finding design-token drift between selected layers and the team library. Use a dense inspector layout with three severity groups, before/after swatches, bulk selection, and a sticky Fix 12 values button. Aim for polished high-fidelity desktop UI.

scene.name: Token drift inspector
scene.altText: A hand-drawn token drift inspector interface concept.

entries.title: Accessibility annotation overlay
entries.prompt: Sketch a browser plugin that overlays numbered accessibility issues directly on a checkout page. Show contrast, missing-label, and keyboard-order pins plus a small floating issue tray. The underlying page should remain visible and the overlay must feel lightweight rather than modal.

scene.name: Accessibility annotation overlay
scene.altText: A hand-drawn accessibility annotation overlay interface concept.

entries.title: Incident command palette
entries.prompt: Prototype a Slack incident-response plugin opened as a command palette. Include a natural-language search field, recent incidents, suggested actions, keyboard shortcuts, and one destructive Escalate action separated from routine commands. Dark terminal-inspired styling, but still readable.

scene.name: Incident command palette
scene.altText: A hand-drawn incident command palette interface concept.

entries.title: Focus-time settings
entries.prompt: Create the settings screen for a calendar plugin that automatically protects focus time. Show working-hour constraints, minimum block length, preferred mornings, excluded calendars, and a preview of next week's proposed blocks. Use friendly consumer SaaS styling and clear toggle states.

scene.name: Focus-time settings
scene.altText: A hand-drawn focus-time settings interface concept.

entries.title: Query explainer
entries.prompt: Design an inline database IDE plugin that explains a slow SQL query beside the editor. Show the query plan as a short vertical flow, highlight the expensive join, estimate savings, and offer an Apply index suggestion button. Keep the information hierarchy technical and compact.

scene.name: Query explainer
scene.altText: A hand-drawn query explainer interface concept.

entries.title: Screenshot feedback pins
entries.prompt: Prototype a screenshot-feedback plugin where reviewers pin comments onto a captured product screen. Show three resolved pins, one active comment thread, assignee and priority controls, and a Share review button. Use low-fidelity hand-drawn wireframe styling.

scene.name: Screenshot feedback pins
scene.altText: A hand-drawn screenshot feedback pins interface concept.

entries.title: API replay timeline
entries.prompt: Create a developer-tools plugin for replaying an API request step by step. Show request, authentication, redirects, response, and retry events on a horizontal timeline with one failed stage expanded. Add compact Replay from here and Copy curl controls.

scene.name: API replay timeline
scene.altText: A hand-drawn api replay timeline interface concept.

entries.title: Citation checker
entries.prompt: Design a Markdown editor sidebar plugin that checks citations against linked sources. Show verified, ambiguous, and missing-source groups, a selected sentence with matching evidence, and a Fix citation action. The screen should feel editorial, calm, and optimized for long-form writing.

scene.name: Citation checker
scene.altText: A hand-drawn citation checker interface concept.

entries.title: Password health dashboard
entries.prompt: Prototype a password-manager health plugin dashboard with overall risk score, reused passwords, stale credentials, passkey readiness, and a recent breach warning. Avoid fear-heavy visuals; use a reassuring card layout with progressive disclosure and accessible color contrast.

scene.name: Password health dashboard
scene.altText: A hand-drawn password health dashboard interface concept.

entries.title: Transcript highlights
entries.prompt: Create an audio-editing plugin that turns a transcript into highlight clips. Show the waveform, timestamped transcript lines, two selected quotes, speaker filters, and a Create 30-second clip action. Desktop split-pane layout with medium fidelity.

scene.name: Transcript highlights
scene.altText: A hand-drawn transcript highlights interface concept.

entries.title: Price history overlay
entries.prompt: Sketch a shopping-browser plugin overlay on a product page that shows ninety-day price history, the typical range, a genuine-discount verdict, and an alert threshold. Keep it narrow enough not to cover the buy controls and show the current-price spike state.

scene.name: Price history overlay
scene.altText: A hand-drawn price history overlay interface concept.

entries.title: Asset deduplicator empty state
entries.prompt: Design the empty state for a design-asset deduplication plugin after a successful scan finds no duplicates. Remove marketing language; show a simple success illustration, scanned-library summary, last scan time, and one Scan another folder action.

scene.name: Asset deduplicator empty state
scene.altText: A hand-drawn asset deduplicator empty state interface concept.

entries.title: Environment switcher
entries.prompt: Prototype a local-development environment switcher that lives in a compact system tray popover. Show three projects, branch and port status, one sleeping environment, resource usage, and quick Start, Open, and Stop actions. Dense macOS-style utility UI.

scene.name: Environment switcher
scene.altText: A hand-drawn environment switcher interface concept.

entries.title: Support macro suggester
entries.prompt: Create a customer-support plugin beside a live ticket that suggests response macros based on sentiment and account context. Show confidence, editable variables, policy warnings, and a Preview reply state. Human-in-the-loop controls should be obvious.

scene.name: Support macro suggester
scene.altText: A hand-drawn support macro suggester interface concept.

entries.title: Command permissions modal
entries.prompt: Design a confirmation modal for a CLI-launcher plugin before it runs a command that writes files and calls the network. Show the exact command, affected workspace, two requested permissions, remember-choice checkbox, Cancel, and Run once. High-trust developer styling.

scene.name: Command permissions modal
scene.altText: A hand-drawn command permissions modal interface concept.

entries.title: Prompt version diff
entries.prompt: Prototype an AI prompt-versioning plugin with a side-by-side semantic diff, test-set score changes, model and temperature metadata, reviewer comments, and Promote version action. Show one regression warning and keep the comparison scannable on a laptop screen.

scene.name: Prompt version diff
scene.altText: A hand-drawn prompt version diff interface concept.

entries.title: Bank transfer confirmation
entries.prompt: Design a mobile banking transfer-confirmation screen for sending $840 to a new recipient. Show recipient verification, arrival date, fee breakdown, fraud reminder, and a press-and-hold confirmation control. Calm, high-trust visual style with large touch targets.

scene.name: Bank transfer confirmation
scene.altText: A hand-drawn bank transfer confirmation interface concept.

entries.title: Restaurant table plan
entries.prompt: Prototype a tablet floor-plan screen for a busy restaurant host. Show occupied, reserved, cleaning, and available tables, a waiting-party queue, drag-to-assign interaction, and a selected party needing wheelchair access. Landscape tablet layout optimized for quick scanning.

scene.name: Restaurant table plan
scene.altText: A hand-drawn restaurant table plan interface concept.

entries.title: Video export queue
entries.prompt: Create a desktop video editor's export-queue screen with one active 4K render, two queued social cuts, progress and time remaining, GPU usage, pause controls, and one failed export with a retry explanation. Dark creative-tool styling.

scene.name: Video export queue
scene.altText: A hand-drawn video export queue interface concept.

entries.title: Analytics loading state
entries.prompt: Design the loading state for a web analytics dashboard while a large date range is being calculated. Keep the navigation and filters usable, use subdued skeletons for four metric cards and one chart, explain the delay, and avoid fake data flashing before results arrive.

scene.name: Analytics loading state
scene.altText: A hand-drawn analytics loading state interface concept.

entries.title: Low-stock product page
entries.prompt: Prototype a responsive e-commerce product detail screen for a handmade lamp with only two left. Show image gallery, material variants, delivery estimate, transparent low-stock messaging, reviews, and Add to cart without using manipulative countdown timers. Warm editorial style.

scene.name: Low-stock product page
scene.altText: A hand-drawn low-stock product page interface concept.

entries.title: Appointment reschedule
entries.prompt: Create a healthcare appointment-rescheduling screen showing the current specialist visit, a two-week calendar, three accessible time slots, travel distance, insurance status, and a warning that changing loses the original slot. Mobile web, reassuring and plain-language.

scene.name: Appointment reschedule
scene.altText: A hand-drawn appointment reschedule interface concept.

entries.title: Collaborative music queue
entries.prompt: Design a collaborative music queue for a living-room party. Show who added each song, emoji voting, a protected host section, duplicate-song feedback, and the now-playing card. Playful color, but controls must remain usable from across the room.

scene.name: Collaborative music queue
scene.altText: A hand-drawn collaborative music queue interface concept.

entries.title: Thermostat offline
entries.prompt: Prototype the offline state of a smart-home thermostat screen. Preserve the last known temperature and schedule, clearly separate unavailable remote actions, show troubleshooting steps, and allow a local-only fallback. Avoid an alarming full-screen error treatment.

scene.name: Thermostat offline
scene.altText: A hand-drawn thermostat offline interface concept.

entries.title: Travel itinerary map
entries.prompt: Create a desktop travel itinerary with a map-and-list split view for a three-day Lisbon trip. Show timed stops, walking routes, reservation status, weather disruption, and an unscheduled saved place that can be dragged into the plan. Airy cartographic style.

scene.name: Travel itinerary map
scene.altText: A hand-drawn travel itinerary map interface concept.

entries.title: Kanban bulk selection
entries.prompt: Design a kanban board in bulk-selection mode with seven cards selected across three columns. Replace normal card actions with a sticky bulk toolbar for assignee, due date, move, archive, and clear selection. Show one locked card that cannot be moved.

scene.name: Kanban bulk selection
scene.altText: A hand-drawn kanban bulk selection interface concept.

entries.title: Permissions onboarding
entries.prompt: Prototype a three-step mobile onboarding screen asking for notifications, calendar access, and location only when each benefit becomes relevant. Show step two with calendar permission declined, a clear Not now path, and no guilt-inducing copy. Friendly illustrated fidelity.

scene.name: Permissions onboarding
scene.altText: A hand-drawn permissions onboarding interface concept.

entries.title: Address validation error
entries.prompt: Create a checkout shipping-address form after validation finds an apartment number mismatch. Preserve every entered value, compare the typed and suggested addresses, explain the delivery risk, and offer Use mine or Use suggested. Desktop web with accessible error placement.

scene.name: Address validation error
scene.altText: A hand-drawn address validation error interface concept.

entries.title: Search no results
entries.prompt: Design a no-results state for searching a large team knowledge base for an uncommon acronym. Keep the query and filters visible, suggest close matches and people to ask, expose a Clear filters action, and avoid generic empty-state marketing copy.

scene.name: Search no results
scene.altText: A hand-drawn search no results interface concept.

entries.title: Workout pause watch
entries.prompt: Prototype a smartwatch workout screen paused during a rainy run. Show elapsed time, heart rate, GPS quality, water-lock status, and large Resume and End controls that work with wet fingers. High contrast, glanceable, no scrolling.

scene.name: Workout pause watch
scene.altText: A hand-drawn workout pause watch interface concept.

entries.title: TV profile picker
entries.prompt: Design a television streaming profile picker for five household members, including one child profile and one temporary guest. Show the focused remote-control state, content-rating cue, Manage profiles secondary action, and safe overscan spacing on a 16:9 screen.

scene.name: TV profile picker
scene.altText: A hand-drawn tv profile picker interface concept.

entries.title: AR furniture placement
entries.prompt: Prototype a mobile AR furniture-placement screen after a sofa has been anchored. Show rotate and scale gestures, wall clearance warning, dimension toggle, change fabric, undo, and Add to room. Keep controls around the edges so the object stays visible.

scene.name: AR furniture placement
scene.altText: A hand-drawn ar furniture placement interface concept.

entries.title: Email triage split pane
entries.prompt: Create a desktop email triage screen with inbox list, selected message, AI summary, reply draft, and keyboard-first archive, snooze, and assign actions. Show an urgent customer escalation and a privacy warning before inserting account data.

scene.name: Email triage split pane
scene.altText: A hand-drawn email triage split pane interface concept.

entries.title: Neighborhood tool library
entries.prompt: Sketch an early product concept for neighbors lending rarely used tools. Show nearby inventory, trust signals, pickup windows, a drill detail card, and a simple request flow. Prioritize community safety and availability over social-feed features; mobile-first medium fidelity.

scene.name: Neighborhood tool library
scene.altText: A hand-drawn neighborhood tool library interface concept.

entries.title: Async standup room
entries.prompt: Prototype an async standup room for a remote product team across five time zones. Combine short video or text updates, blockers, reactions, and a synthesized handoff timeline. Show two people who have not checked in without making the screen feel punitive.

scene.name: Async standup room
scene.altText: A hand-drawn async standup room interface concept.

entries.title: Leftovers meal planner
entries.prompt: Design an early mobile concept that turns photographed leftovers into a three-day meal plan. Show detected ingredients with confidence, dietary exclusions, two recipe cards, expiry urgency, and a way to correct recognition before generating the plan. Friendly scrapbook visual style.

scene.name: Leftovers meal planner
scene.altText: A hand-drawn leftovers meal planner interface concept.

entries.title: Family care coordinator
entries.prompt: Prototype a private family coordination app for supporting an older parent. Show today's medication, transport, meal, and check-in tasks, who owns each item, one missed task, and a calm escalation path. Large type, clear privacy boundaries, no infantilizing language.

scene.name: Family care coordinator
scene.altText: A hand-drawn family care coordinator interface concept.

entries.title: Carbon receipt
entries.prompt: Sketch a digital receipt that estimates the carbon impact of a grocery basket. Group impact by food, packaging, and transport, communicate uncertainty, compare one practical swap, and let the user hide the score. Receipt-like mobile layout, neutral rather than moralizing.

scene.name: Carbon receipt
scene.altText: A hand-drawn carbon receipt interface concept.

entries.title: Repairability scanner
entries.prompt: Prototype a phone camera experience that scans an appliance label and estimates repairability. Show recognized model, confidence, common faults, parts availability, local repair options, and a clear unsupported-model state. Rugged utility styling suitable for a workshop.

scene.name: Repairability scanner
scene.altText: A hand-drawn repairability scanner interface concept.

entries.title: Commute micro-learning
entries.prompt: Design a micro-learning product for a twelve-minute train commute. Show one adaptive lesson, download status, progress across the week, audio/text mode, a confidence check, and graceful handling when the trip ends early. Mobile, distraction-light, low-data mode.

scene.name: Commute micro-learning
scene.altText: A hand-drawn commute micro-learning interface concept.

entries.title: Scope-creep tracker
entries.prompt: Prototype a freelancer dashboard that spots scope creep by comparing a signed proposal with incoming requests. Show three detected changes, estimated extra effort, client-friendly clarification language, and an approval trail. Serious but non-confrontational desktop UI.

scene.name: Scope-creep tracker
scene.altText: A hand-drawn scope-creep tracker interface concept.

entries.title: Quiet coworking match
entries.prompt: Sketch a service that matches remote workers for silent two-hour coworking sessions. Show availability overlap, focus preferences, camera comfort, lightweight reputation, and a matched-session lobby. Avoid dating-app patterns; calm, minimal, privacy-forward design.

scene.name: Quiet coworking match
scene.altText: A hand-drawn quiet coworking match interface concept.

entries.title: Community garden planner
entries.prompt: Design a shared community-garden planner with plot map, seasonal crop rotation, watering rota, shared tool status, and a conflict where two members selected the same bed. Tablet-friendly illustrated interface that remains usable outdoors in bright light.

scene.name: Community garden planner
scene.altText: A hand-drawn community garden planner interface concept.

entries.title: School pickup coordinator
entries.prompt: Prototype a school pickup coordination screen for three families sharing rides. Show verified guardians, today's route, child handoff confirmations, late-driver alert, and an emergency fallback. Mobile-first, high trust, with actions usable one-handed.

scene.name: School pickup coordinator
scene.altText: A hand-drawn school pickup coordinator interface concept.

entries.title: Pet medication routine
entries.prompt: Create an early product screen for coordinating a pet's medication between household members. Show dose schedule, remaining supply, photo confirmation, side-effect notes, vet instructions, and one missed dose awaiting guidance. Warm but clinically clear mobile design.

scene.name: Pet medication routine
scene.altText: A hand-drawn pet medication routine interface concept.

entries.title: Local event buddy
entries.prompt: Sketch a local-events product that helps someone attend alone without forced networking. Show an event detail, optional low-pressure buddy matching, arrival window, conversation preferences, safety check-in, and a Browse without matching path. Inclusive consumer styling.

scene.name: Local event buddy
scene.altText: A hand-drawn local event buddy interface concept.

entries.title: Sponsorship pipeline
entries.prompt: Prototype a lightweight sponsorship pipeline for a small creator. Show prospect, negotiating, contracted, and delivered stages; expected revenue; deliverables; usage-rights warning; and one overdue invoice. Desktop kanban with spreadsheet-level clarity.

scene.name: Sponsorship pipeline
scene.altText: A hand-drawn sponsorship pipeline interface concept.

entries.title: Digital estate plan
entries.prompt: Design an early digital-estate planning dashboard for organizing accounts, devices, documents, and instructions for trusted contacts. Show completion progress, encrypted items, review dates, and what each contact can access. Quiet, high-trust, non-morbid visual language.

scene.name: Digital estate plan
scene.altText: A hand-drawn digital estate plan interface concept.

entries.title: Hobby parts inventory
entries.prompt: Prototype a visual parts inventory for someone building small electronics projects. Show labeled bins, quantities, reserved parts, low-stock chips, project allocations, barcode scan, and a Find on shelf interaction. Desktop plus phone companion concept, playful workshop style.

scene.name: Hobby parts inventory
scene.altText: A hand-drawn hobby parts inventory interface concept.
